```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hide'}
library(pheatmap)
library(limma)
library(data.table)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)

result_folder = paste("../../../../Results/ClonalCultures/DNAm",format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d"),sep="/")
if (!file.exists(result_folder)) dir.create(result_folder, recursive=T)

data_storage_folder = "../../../../Data/Processed/ClonalCultures/DNAm"
if (!file.exists(data_storage_folder)) dir.create(data_storage_folder, recursive=T)

source("../../../Utils/pheatmap.type.R")

```


# Overview

We here use data on CpGs specifically unmethylated in selected tissues from the WGS Atlas to classify samples. 

```{r}
load("../../../../Data/Processed/ClonalCultures/DNAm/myNorm_IM_nonIM_and_healthy_stomach_450k_and_EPIC.RData")

load("../../../../Data/Processed/ClonalCultures/DNAm/myLoad_IM_nonIM_and_healthy_stomach_450k_and_EPIC_combined.RData")

ed = myLoad$pd |> as.data.frame()
ed$SampleLabel <- ifelse(ed$Project=="2020-186-ILL", paste0(ed$Sample_Group, "_", ed$PatientID, "_", ed$CloneID), ed$Sample_Name )
```

```{r}
cpgs <- read_excel("../../../../Data/ExtData/Other_Methylation_data/GSE186458_WGBS_Atlas/Supp/41586_2022_5580_MOESM4_ESM.xlsx", sheet = "Table S12", skip = 1) |> as.data.frame()

cpgs_filt <- subset(cpgs, cpgs$`CpG accession` %in% rownames(myNorm))
```

# All specifically unmethylated CpGs from the WGS Atlas represented on the 450k array 


```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
mm = myNorm[cpgs_filt$`CpG accession`, ]

row_anno = cpgs_filt[, "Type",drop=F]
rownames(row_anno) <- cpgs_filt$`CpG accession`

pheatmap(mm, scale="none", cluster_rows = F, show_rownames = F, annotation_row = row_anno, labels_col = ed[colnames(mm), "SampleLabel"])
```


```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
mm_avg = limma::avereps(mm, row_anno[rownames(mm), "Type"])

pheatmap(mm_avg, scale="none", cluster_rows = T, labels_col = ed[colnames(mm), "SampleLabel"], main = "All specifically unmethylated CpGs in the IM cohort, averaged per tissue type")
```


# Only Gastric/Colon/SI specific CpGs

```{r}
cpgs_filt2 <- subset(cpgs, cpgs$`CpG accession` %in% rownames(myNorm) & Type %in% c("Gastric-Ep","Colon-Ep","Small-Int-Ep"))
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
mm = myNorm[cpgs_filt2$`CpG accession`, ]

row_anno = cpgs_filt2[, "Type",drop=F]
rownames(row_anno) <- cpgs_filt2$`CpG accession`

pheatmap(mm, scale="none", cluster_rows = F, show_rownames = F, annotation_row = row_anno, labels_col = ed[colnames(mm), "SampleLabel"])
pheatmap.type(mm, type="Type", conditions = c("Gastric-Ep","Colon-Ep","Small-Int-Ep"), scale="none", show_rownames = F, annRow = row_anno, labels_col = ed[colnames(mm), "SampleLabel"])
```

```{r}
cpgs_filt3 <- subset(cpgs, cpgs$`CpG accession` %in% rownames(myNorm) & Type %in% c("Gastric-Ep"))
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
mm = myNorm[cpgs_filt3$`CpG accession`, ]

mm_ts <- reshape2::melt(mm)
colnames(mm_ts) <- c("cpg_id", "sample_id", "beta")

ed$Sample_Group2 <- ifelse(ed$Project == "2020-186-ILL", paste0("Clonal-",ed$Sample_Group), ifelse(ed$Project=="KFR_IM", paste0("Polyclonal-",ed$Sample_Group), paste0("Healthy-", ed$Stomach_site)) )

ed$Sample_Group2 <- factor(ed$Sample_Group2, levels=c("Healthy-Antrum","Healthy-Corpus","Healthy-Fundus","Polyclonal-Normal","Clonal-non-IM","Polyclonal-Atrophy","Polyclonal-IM","Clonal-IM"))

mm_ts$group <- ed[mm_ts$sample_id, "Sample_Group2"]

mm_ts <- subset(mm_ts, !group == "Polyclonal-Atrophy")

  ggplot(mm_ts, aes(x=group, y=beta, col=group)) + geom_point() + facet_wrap(~cpg_id) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1)) + stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "crossbar") + ggtitle("Gastric specific unmethylated CpGs across the IM cohort samples")
```

```{r}
cpgs_filt3 <- subset(cpgs, cpgs$`CpG accession` %in% rownames(myNorm) & Type %in% c("Colon-Ep","Small-Int-Ep"))
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
mm = myNorm[cpgs_filt3$`CpG accession`, ]

mm_ts <- reshape2::melt(mm)
colnames(mm_ts) <- c("cpg_id", "sample_id", "beta")

ed$Sample_Group2 <- ifelse(ed$Project == "2020-186-ILL", paste0("Clonal-",ed$Sample_Group), ifelse(ed$Project=="KFR_IM", paste0("Polyclonal-",ed$Sample_Group), paste0("Healthy-", ed$Stomach_site)) )

ed$Sample_Group2 <- factor(ed$Sample_Group2, levels=c("Healthy-Antrum","Healthy-Corpus","Healthy-Fundus","Polyclonal-Normal","Clonal-non-IM","Polyclonal-Atrophy","Polyclonal-IM","Clonal-IM"))

mm_ts$group <- ed[mm_ts$sample_id, "Sample_Group2"]

mm_ts <- subset(mm_ts, !group == "Polyclonal-Atrophy")

ggplot(mm_ts, aes(x=group, y=beta, col=group)) + geom_point() + facet_wrap(~cpg_id) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1)) + stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "crossbar") + ggtitle("intestinal (Colon/SI) specific unmethylated CpGs across the IM cohort samples")
```
